required_regex: Do not assume a specific repository

cases.prompt: Change the first line of the README to "Toolset". This task is unrelated to Rust, Node, or native modules.

I have an existing Rust domain crate and want to expose an async analyze(path, options) API to Node with napi-rs. Give a generic design and verification plan first; do not create a package or write code.
This napi-rs addon reads large files, processes Buffers on a background thread, then calls back into JavaScript. Explain the thread, lifetime, and testing boundaries without writing code.
Explain how to run napi pre-publish and publish to npm. Check release readiness first and do not perform any external operations.
Can the local napi-rs documentation inventory prove it still covers the official site? Describe how to verify that without updating files.
